searchText: famous last words Nimbus has merged its https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5543 change Reminder that nightly reftests are a thing! And it should be possible to pin against a specific run ID. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5550 is this part of devnet8? <@&1417820113981145228> send it 😂 I am torn about that one We might also want to do this one: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5553 I think it's fine to have an empty bid on the fork instead the slot should come from the header which is not a consensus breaking change ah shit now I will be blamed 😂 > As suggested by <@586161934425128960> via a DM I think the problem was using the slot from the bid in Justin's PR Which PR? lol https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5473 The issue raised by NC is that the lookup for the slot coming from here would be incorrect, but that's just cause the slot is being picked up from the bid, instead of using the header and caching the slot in `process_block_header` neither of these is a consensus breaking change, so I'd leave the fork as is, and just use the header as the source for the parent block instead of the bid this is part of devnet8 though, everyone implemented it did you already merged NC's PR? it was proposed 13 hours ago! WTF? Yes, I did. I didn't realize it would be controversial. it's not really controversial I don't care much, but it's quite hard to follow the spec and that is a consensus breaking change while just moving the slot from the header would not be If others agree with your idea, we can do that instead. I am unsure if it's practical. NC did fix an issue though. Let me make a PR to see. can someone please tell me what we want for devnet8, im worry that we may fork. We want NC's change or do nothing Just wait for now please. <@755590043632140352> such a change would look like this: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/compare/master...jtraglia:consensus-specs:use-slot-from-header What do you think? Note, it needs to be cached before `process_block_header`. I still think NC's change was good btw. And we should merge this one as well. yeah that's the change I had in mind, but not putting the bid fields to something not-trivial, eg leaving the slot as 0, since the latest execution payload bid at the fork is semantically inexistent. It has the advantage of not being neither consensus breaking nor changing any code on clients if they already cached it from the parent block's slot so it's purely cosmetical doing it this way, rather than breaking consensus Pretty sure it would still be consensus breaking vs what currently exists on devnet-8. In the event of missed slots before the upgrade. Also, doesn't it feel a bit weird to have the first `state.latest_execution_payload_bid` be associated with builder 0 instead of `BUILDER_INDEX_SELF_BUILD`? why? I mean not changing anything in the fork.md, just change the slot in your PR, taking it from the header so the bid's slot still remains zero and revert NC's PR that is not a consensus breaking change and will not penalize attestations ah you mean it's a consensus breaking change at the fork yeah that's true crap 🙁 yeah, NVM, either way requires coordination 😢 Anyway, I don't have any strong feelings about this. Happy to do it either way. Whatever clients want. I still do believe we should initialize those other bid fields though. cc <@586161934425128960> <@1035747431461167125> <@363800010518822915> <@654267572107083777> <@358120958726373381> <@641548687813902336> and others Made this PR if we want to leave feedback on github instead: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5554 I don't see any harm in setting latest bid.slot to pre.latest_block_header.slot since its block_hash and execution_requests_root have already been set to a fulu payload anyway if we are worried about semantics. And I think leaving slot to 0 is more confusing. It will become a cosmetic thing instead of an actual fix if we adopt <@592004585506340885> 's change. That being said I like <@592004585506340885> 's change. Clean, `parent_slot = state.latest_block_header.slot` is definitely correct and process_execution_payload_bid not returning parent slot is good Thanks <@1035747431461167125> 🙏 <@755590043632140352> would you be fine with 5554 and 5553? > And I think leaving slot to 0 is more confusing. It will become a cosmetic thing instead of an actual fix It's a bit of both. Potuz's change also fixes the issue you pointed out, but I agree that having a slot=0, builder=0, etc there is confusing. Eg I could see this being annoying for chain explorers. Having to hardcoded in that the first bid is not actually associated with slot 0 and builder 0. can we just merge them all and do a `alpha.14` so there is no ambiguity on what's needed on devnet-8? Yep we could. I would like that. <@755590043632140352> what do you think? Can we compromise here? I don't mind any of these changes much, I just don't like the pace at which these things are being merged and the quantity of these merges, there are some timezones in which people couldn't have even read the e-mail with NC's PR, and we're talking on putting this on devnet 8 which is public and will fork in a couple of days. by default I would have left all of these out and merged in a week or so when we're talking about another round of tests Yeah we can slow down a bit. We were about to make the alpha.14 release (for focil devnet-0) and NC's PR was notable enough (a real bug fix) that it merited a quick merge. Client devs, please just review the two PRs as soon as you can & we'll merge them (or not) when there is sufficient support.

I don't see any harm in setting latest bid.slot to pre.latest_block_header.slot since its block_hash and execution_requests_root have already been set to a fulu payload anyway if we are worried about semantics. And I think leaving slot to 0 is more confusing. It will become a cosmetic thing instead of an actual fix if we adopt <@592004585506340885> 's change.
That being said I like <@592004585506340885> 's change. Clean, `parent_slot = state.latest_block_header.slot` is definitely correct and process_execution_payload_bid not returning parent slot is good
